note: Honorifics dropped. Lines 5-50 are a two-column custodian list; each name was assigned to a column by position in the text, so two names often share one line (e.g. Doiron/Crosby line 11). Left column: Supervisor, then Senior High School, then Turkey Hill Middle School; right column: Turkey Hill (Continued), Passios, then Elementary Annex. Dates/'Began..replacing..'/'Last day' lines ignored. Judgement calls: Haynes's title is split across lines 35-36 (Junior Custodian / Groundsman-Custodian) and both are recorded; Limoges prints only '1964' with no title; Archambault's office is Brooks House but he supervises all buildings so district-wide; the Annex has no school value. Column assignment of lines 34-50 is the least certain part of the page.
